summary.text: Rick Kloos is a Republican member of the Kansas Senate representing District 3 (Shawnee County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2021.
Rick Kloos is listed as a vice chair of the Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: Rick Kloos is listed as a member of the Ways and Means Committee, the Commerce Committee and the Transportation Committee.
The Legislature lists Rick Kloos's occupation as Director of God's Storehouse.
The page names Pennie as Rick Kloos's spouse.
